changes: Commit queued application data and TCP sequence bookkeeping before cancellable transport writes.
Add payload-free TCP sequence/window metadata to trace logs and retransmission timeout diagnostics.
Use a per-connection retransmission timer with a 1s initial RTO, capped exponential backoff and timer renewal only on valid ACK progress; trim partial ACKs and reject ACKs beyond transmitted data.
Add paused-time WAN regression tests, including batched advancing ACKs matching the VPS retransmission burst.
Retain upstream test dependencies; privileged manual TUN tests are skipped in hardware-free unit verification.
